analyses.summary_en: The war is getting more raw when Russia openly admits to bombing everything and everyone in Ukraine, which is part of the Russian General Staff's doctrine of non-contact war and active defense, which includes tying down the opponent in a war of attrition, but at the same time nothing changes at the front and Russia can be considered stuck with only symbolic successes at a huge price in losses. Russia is taking worse losses than ever.
key_takeaways_sv: Ryssland tar värre förluster än någonsin.
Kremls uppfattning om var fronten går är förmodligen en stor verklighetsvariation, varför Kreml tror att det går bättre än det gör.
Den ukrainska motståndviljan är obruten enligt opinionsundersökningar och enligt uppgifter glöder det fortfarande i ögonen på folket i Kyjiv, trots konstanta flyglarm och terrorbombningar.
key_takeaways_en: Russia is taking worse losses than ever.
The Kremlin's perception of where the front is going is probably a big variation from reality, which is why the Kremlin thinks things are going better than it is.
The Ukrainian will to resist is unbroken according to opinion polls and, according to reports, it still glows in the eyes of the people of Kyiv, despite constant air raids and terrorist bombings.

analyses.title_en: Do European leaders understand how security is changing?
analyses.summary_sv: Europeiska ledare insisterar på att Nato redan tillhandahåller den säkerhet som Europa behöver. Men antagandena bakom det systemet förändras, och kriget i Ukraina väcker frågor som inte kan besvaras bara genom att peka på Nato. Vad kommer att krävas för att hindra Ryssland från att angripa Europa i framtiden, och är de europeiska ledarna förberedda på de förändringar som ligger framför oss?
analyses.summary_en: European leaders insist that NATO already provides the security Europe needs. But the assumptions behind that system are changing, and the war in Ukraine is raising questions that cannot be answered simply by pointing to NATO. What will it take to keep Russia from attacking Europe in the future, and are European leaders prepared for the changes ahead?

analyses.title_en: The Battle of the Bridges - The Crimean Bridge & Russia's Strike Campaign
analyses.summary_sv: Det har inte varit en bra vecka att vara en bro i Ukrainakriget. Även om Krim väckte stor uppmärksamhet, utspelar sig också en mycket bredare kampanj, där Ryssland riktar in sig på stora ukrainska broar och båda sidor visar förbättringar i sina arsenaler.
analyses.summary_en: It hasn't been a good week to be a Bridge in the Ukraine war. While Crimea drew a lot of the attention, a much wider campaign is also playing out, with Russia targeting major Ukrainian bridges and both sides demonstrating improvements in their arsenals.
key_takeaways_sv: Det har inte varit en bra vecka att vara en bro i Ukrainakriget.
Även om Krim väckte stor uppmärksamhet, utspelar sig också en mycket bredare kampanj, där Ryssland riktar in sig på stora ukrainska broar och båda sidor visar förbättringar i sina arsenaler.
Så idag, låt oss titta på slaget vid broarna och packa upp vad dessa attacker kan betyda för kriget...och om de är eller inte är värda resurserna som används för att gå efter dem.
key_takeaways_en: It hasn't been a good week to be a Bridge in the Ukraine war.
While Crimea drew a lot of the attention, a much wider campaign is also playing out, with Russia targeting major Ukrainian bridges and both sides demonstrating improvements in their arsenals.
So today, let's look at the battle of the bridges and unpack what these strikes might mean for the war...and whether they are or aren't worth the resources being used to go after them.

analyses.summary_sv: Hade lite annat på gång att skriva om typ Hearts of Iron 4 och Bosnien men så sitter man här på kontoret sent på natten i förrgår er tid och det börjar komma blänkare om att vägbanan på Kertjbron hänger dystert.
analyses.summary_en: Had a few other things going on to write about like Hearts of Iron 4 and Bosnia but here I am at the office late at night the night before yesterday your time and reports start coming in that the road surface on the Kerch Bridge is hanging grimly. Then another about more flamingos en-route, and while still trying to remember the dance steps a third comes in about another operation with multiple pink flamingos.
key_takeaways_sv: Hade lite annat på gång att skriva om typ Hearts of Iron 4 och Bosnien men så sitter man här på kontoret sent på natten i förrgår er tid och det börjar komma blänkare om att vägbanan på Kertjbron hänger dystert.

Sen en till om fler flamingos en-route, och när man fortfarande försöker komma ihåg dansstegen kommer ett tredje om ytterligare en insats med multipla rosa flamingos.- där började man förstå att beslutet var fattat och att Zelensky tryckt ned röd knapp i botten med ett brett flin.
När man så vaknar på morgonen är det till dessa videos och roligare att kliva upp har det nog aldrig varit.
key_takeaways_en: Had a few other things going on to write about like Hearts of Iron 4 and Bosnia but here I am at the office late at night the night before yesterday your time and reports start coming in that the road surface on the Kerch Bridge is hanging grimly.
Then another about more flamingos en-route, and while still trying to remember the dance steps a third comes in about another operation with multiple pink flamingos.
That’s when it started to become clear that the decision was made and Zelensky had pressed the red button all the way down with a wide grin.

Men på upphandlingsnivå kan det bli komplicerat. analyses.summary_sv: As Ukraine has intensified its strikes on Russian infrastructure, including the Russian retail giant Wildberries in July, debate over the effectiveness of the campaign has spread across both social and traditional media, often with nearly as much frequency as the strikes themselves. Commentators have offered differing assessments of their significance, some even arguing that it’s simply performative.
analyses.summary_en: As Ukraine has intensified its strikes on Russian infrastructure, including the Russian retail giant Wildberries in July, debate over the effectiveness of the campaign has spread across both social and traditional media, often with nearly as much frequency as the strikes themselves. Commentators have offered differing assessments of their significance, some even arguing that it’s simply performative.
key_takeaways_sv: As Ukraine has intensified its strikes on Russian infrastructure, including the Russian retail giant Wildberries in July, debate over the effectiveness of the campaign has spread across both social and traditional media, often with nearly as much frequency as the strikes themselves.
Commentators have offered differing assessments of their significance, some even arguing that it’s simply performative.
Much of the public discussion has focused on the immediate retail consequences, including the loss of warehouse capacity, destroyed goods, and the financial damage suffered by Wildberries itself.
